description: The closed set of failure conditions, their codes, their retryability, their closed cause sets, and the order in which one call reports the first that holds.

cases.name: closed-set
cases.note: the closed set is exactly these sixteen.  A binding renders each as the idiom of its language and changes neither the code nor the name.

conditions.name: noCandidate
conditions.callerResponse: inspect the topology; the same key answers the same way

conditions.name: exhausted
conditions.condition: the attempt sequence ran out after at least one attempt
conditions.callerResponse: back off, then retry; a retryBudget cause means the cluster is shedding

conditions.name: unready
conditions.callerResponse: wait for a first document, bounded by initialTimeoutMillis

conditions.name: staleSnapshot
conditions.condition: the snapshot in force is stale and the policy is refuse
conditions.callerResponse: wait for the provider, or serve the request from another region

conditions.name: invalidArgument
conditions.condition: a caller-supplied argument is outside the contract

conditions.name: invalidTopology
conditions.condition: a document failed schema or semantic validation
conditions.callerResponse: fix the document at the authority; the snapshot in force is unchanged

conditions.name: topologyConflict
conditions.condition: a differing identifier, or an equal epoch with a new digest
conditions.callerResponse: an authority defect; two writers are publishing one identifier

conditions.name: staleDocument
conditions.condition: an arriving epoch is below the epoch in force or below minEpoch
conditions.callerResponse: none at the caller; the provider is serving a lagging replica

conditions.name: providerError
conditions.condition: the provider failed to deliver a document
conditions.callerResponse: none; the snapshot in force stays in force and the backoff applies

conditions.name: notOwner
conditions.condition: the recipient does not hold the shard for the key
conditions.callerResponse: retry at currentOwner, bounded by maxRedirects

conditions.name: epochMismatch
conditions.condition: the sender is behind or ahead of the recipient

conditions.name: identityMismatch
conditions.callerResponse: operator action; epochs under two identifiers are incomparable

conditions.name: redirectExhausted
conditions.condition: a redirect walk reached its bound or revisited a node
conditions.callerResponse: surface the failure; a retryBudget cause means the cluster is shedding

conditions.name: planRefused
conditions.condition: a plan cannot be built from the two snapshots and the policy
conditions.callerResponse: correct the snapshots or the policy member named in cause

conditions.name: quiesced
conditions.condition: the shard is inside the cutover window
conditions.callerResponse: retry after the window, which commitDeadlineMillis bounds

conditions.name: handoffFailed
conditions.callerResponse: operator action, directed by the failure kind in cause; undetermined takes a re-observation

cases.name: report-order
cases.note: `ERR-008`: where more than one condition holds for one call, the first that holds in this order is reported.

cases.name: shortfall-is-not-a-condition
cases.note: a preference list shorter than the effective replication factor is a successful routing decision, reported through `shortfall` on the decision.

cases.name: error-members
cases.note: every condition carries these members, and none carries the key unless `includeKeysInDiagnostics` is enabled.
